variants.name: REDUCED MAG
variants.info: Swap your magazine for a reduced 10 round capacity magazine! Improves reload speed and handling!

variants.name: 7N31 SAP
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to red tipped super armor piercing rounds.
This cartridge in particular is the 7N31 cartridge, originally designed for use with the GSh-18 pistol. Damage drops off immediately with vastly increased bullet penetration but harshly cuts at suppression and long range damage.

variants.name: Plus P
variants.info:
Overpacked with powder, these rounds aim to make your bullets fly faster, penetrate surfaces better, and increase suppression.
Harder to control.

variants.name: .45 RUBBER
variants.info:
Loads your GSH-18 with .45 Rubber!
Increased damage overall and will always one shot to the head, but extremely poor penetrating power, suppression and velocity!
Requires manual rechambering!

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
